status: PREDECLARED 2026-10-20 before any Part B outcome was computed. Research only: no live, MT5, BAT, SET, package or guard change.
request: Owner 2026-10-20: test the pasted claim ('PF > 0.95 + a large number of uncorrelated bets is enough to profit from prop firms') with our EAs, build the best portfolio of EAs / settings, show median pass rate and pass days in tables.
part_a_theory: theory.py: i.i.d. 1:1 bets under FTMO 2-step Swing $10k rules, PF 0.90-1.20, risk 0.25-2%, 3 or 10 bets/day, 20,000 paths, plus a 40-trading-day funded-payout illustration (fee ~USD 170 assumed). Pure maths, no market data.

part_b_universe.ftmo_package_eas: the 16 FTMO-package EAs of FTMO Fastest Funded Search 2026-10-20 (ftmo mapping, FTMO-compiled native runs)
part_b_universe.extra_source: Portfolio Long History All ORB05 2026-10-14 'full-eas' native 5-year runs (normal builds; signals as deployed in the normal BATs), same mark-ownership and stop-risk rules; an EA failing the model assertions is excluded before outcomes
part_b_universe.excluded: news EAs (FTMO straddle permission unclear; FTMO launcher runs News OFF), hourly profiles (no stop loss, risk undefined), 3 Way Gold (overlapping modules), Gold News V9 (no evidence), BTC/ETH/XAG/EURUSD/US30 EAs (FTMO contract specs not modelled; not invented)

pf_measure: per-EA profit factor in R = sum(net R > 0) / |sum(net R < 0)| with net R = (unit_gross + unit_commission + unit_swap) / unit_risk, measured ONLY on trades opened in the development window (2021-10-07 .. 2023-10-06)

baskets.LLN_PF095: every universe EA with development PF > 0.95 (the claim's rule)
baskets.LLN_ALL: every universe EA (maximum number of bets)
baskets.EDGE_PF110: every universe EA with development PF > 1.10 (an edge-filtered contrast)
baskets.references: PR9 (Prop Ready) results are taken from FTMO Fastest Funded Search 2026-10-20, not re-selected

guard: standard modelled FTMO guard (DialTrial: aggregate 225*(c/50), same-symbol 150*(c/50), $300 daily latch/reserve, $9,200 buffer, 7 entries / 3 losers per day); candidate tie order = FTMO package order then extras alphabetically
windows: development 2021-10-07..2023-10-06, validation 2023-10-06..2024-10-06, OOS 2024-10-06..2026-10-06 (all previously inspected, retrospective); every configuration is reported in every window (no selection is made from validation or OOS)
metrics: pass rate (both phases <= 180 d, no breach), funded <= 90 d, median days to funded, breaches, buffer stalls, worst equity DD, worst day, trades / month / weekday, number of EAs and bets
claim_test: The claim is supported only if LLN_PF095 at small caps ($25/$50) has a pass rate >= 70% AND beats EDGE_PF110 and PR9 in development and validation. Otherwise it is rejected for our EAs.
tested_configurations: 3 baskets x 4 caps = 12 (plus Part A theory grid of 40 cells)
